local camera=require('openmw.camera')

local route={{}}
local step=1;local elapsed=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during ordinary OrdinaryBook acquisition')
 local stock=Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x26d8b))
 print('OrdinaryBookApproach stock='..stock..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' player='..tostring(self.position))
 if stock>0 then return end
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6efb5))
 if not target then print('OrdinaryBookApproach target absent');return end
 print('OrdinaryBookApproach target original=true')
 print(string.format('OrdinaryBookApproach level aim x=0 y=%d',math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*512+.5)))
 if math.abs(camera.getPitch())<.1 then print('OrdinaryBookApproach pitch level') end
 while step<=#route do
  local delta=route[step]-self.position
  if math.sqrt(delta.x*delta.x+delta.y*delta.y)>48 or math.abs(delta.z)>120 then break end
  print('OrdinaryBookApproach reached waypoint='..step);step=step+1
 end
 if step>#route then print('OrdinaryBookApproach close') end
 local view=camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5));local dv=(route[step] or target.position)-self.position
 local yaw=math.atan2(view.y*dv.x-view.x*dv.y,view.x*dv.x+view.y*dv.y)
 print(string.format('OrdinaryBookApproach walk aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*512+.5)))
 local box=target:getBoundingBox();local origin=camera.getPosition();local aim=nil
 for _,x in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,y in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do for _,z in ipairs({{0,-.6,.6}}) do
  local point=box.center+util.vector3(x*box.halfSize.x,y*box.halfSize.y,z*box.halfSize.z);local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,point,{{ignore=self}})
  if hit.hitObject==target then aim=hit.hitPos;break end
 end;if aim then break end end;if aim then break end end
 local point=camera.getViewTransform():apply(aim or box.center);local ax=math.atan2(point.x,-point.z);local ay=-math.atan2(point.y,math.sqrt(point.x*point.x+point.z*point.z))
 print(string.format('OrdinaryBookApproach item aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ax*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(ay*256+.5)))))
 local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+view*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 if ray.hitObject==target and ray.hitPos and (ray.hitPos-origin):length()<tonumber(core.getGMST('iMaxActivateDist')) then print('OrdinaryBookApproach focused in native range') end
end}}}}
